summary: Gate S remains NOT_RUN. Two things changed since v2. First, review found the repaired decision rule could still return a FALSE YES by three separate routes, and its seed-variation check was grouped so that it could not detect the very defect it existed to catch; all are fixed. Second, and more consequential: the q10/q90 artifacts do not isolate the direction axis at all, so Gate S is now BLOCKED ON EVIDENCE QUALITY as well as on network egress. Rebuilding them is a prerequisite, not a nicety.

the_new_blocking_finding.claim: The current q10/q50/q90 stress cases change TOTAL DEMAND as well as its direction, so a Gate S difference measured on them cannot be attributed to direction.
the_new_blocking_finding.mechanism: dirsplit/predict.py writes edge_shares_q10 as (e0 -> s10, e1 -> 1 - s90) and edge_shares_q90 as (e0 -> s90, e1 -> 1 - s10). Each outer pair therefore sums to 1 -/+ (s90 - s10) rather than 1.

measured.on: sumo/direction_split.json rebuilt in this session from the tracked data/dirsplit/model.pkl

the_new_blocking_finding.why_it_is_fatal_to_the_question: Gate S asks whether the DIRECTION axis changes a closure decision. If the arms also differ in how much traffic exists, a measured difference has two possible causes and nothing afterwards can separate them. A YES would be unattributable and a NO would be unearned.
the_new_blocking_finding.how_it_is_enforced_now: measure_pair_sum_isolation runs at registration time, its result is recorded inside the frozen registration (and therefore inside the content key), main() prints a loud warning, and decide_gate_s returns INCONCLUSIVE when the registration does not certify isolation. A registration that never measured it counts as NOT isolating.
the_new_blocking_finding.prerequisite_for_a_meaningful_run: Rebuild the q artifacts with a pair-sum-preserving construction, so each station's two directed shares sum to 1.0 in every slot of every stress case. That work belongs to Fas 2 and was NOT performed here.

decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.was: A ranking key that varied across seeds was appended to material_reasons, so it produced gate_s = YES.
decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.why_wrong: The deployed ranking key comes from closure_disruption, which is demand-side and congestion-independent, so it CANNOT legitimately vary with the seed. When it does, the matrix has not isolated direction from simulator noise and neither answer is available. Turning a broken measurement into a YES is the worst failure mode this gate has, because YES is what unlocks product work.
decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.now: INCONCLUSIVE, with the violations recorded in the artifact.

decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.was: A candidate disqualified by the no-detour rule in EVERY stress case could still open the gate through its cost spread.
decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.why_wrong: rank_closures never ranks a disqualified candidate against a viable one — a schedule that severs someone's destination is refused whatever it costs. A candidate refused in every case has the same fate in every case, so its cost spread cannot change a decision. Crediting direction with moving a number the policy does not read is a false YES.
decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.now: Such a candidate is marked decision_relevant: false and cannot be material. If EVERY candidate is disqualified in every case, no viable set was ever formed and the outcome is INCONCLUSIVE rather than NO — there was no decision for direction to change.

decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.was: seed_axis_varied grouped observations by stress case alone, pooling all candidates.
decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.why_wrong: Two candidates close different edges and legitimately insert different numbers of vehicles. Pooling them lets a candidate-to-candidate difference stand in for a seed difference, so a matrix in which every seed was byte-identical still reported varied: true — defeating the exact check that exists to catch an inert seed axis.
decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.now: Grouped by (stress case, candidate), and EVERY group must vary. One group that happens to move cannot vouch for a matrix in which the rest were identical runs.

decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.was: A closure window that did not fit the demand build was silently replaced by the whole demand window.
decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.why_wrong: That is the one thing a preregistration exists to prevent: a four-hour closure would have run for twenty-four and nothing in the artifact would have said so.
decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.now: closure_window raises RegistrationError for a window outside the build, a window only partly overlapping it, and a reversed window. No clamp, no substitution.

decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.was: survives_own_closure returned True when sumolib was unavailable, so the topology filter failed OPEN.
decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.why_wrong: An unverifiable filter is not a passed filter. A checkout without SUMO would have frozen a selection containing edges that sever their own downstream pocket.
decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.now: load_network raises rather than degrading, the network is read once and reused, and select_candidates refuses to return a short list.

decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.was: The registered date was never checked against the demand build's own date.
decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.why_wrong: A registration naming 2025-09-16 while the loaded demand is a 2027 forecast day describes an experiment nobody ran.
decision_rule_defects_found_and_fixed.now: validate_registered_date compares against demand_meta.json's date/start_date BEFORE candidate selection runs, and refuses on mismatch.

network.cause: the candidate-route generator fetches OSM POI activity mass from the Overpass API, and SCB DeSO population from geodata.scb.se; this session's policy-enforcing egress proxy denies both
network.proxy_evidence: GET $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status reports recentRelayFailures kind=connect_rejected, detail='gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)' for overpass-api.de:443 and geodata.scb.se:443
network.policy_note: /root/.ccr/README.md states organization policy denials (403/407) must be reported rather than retried, so no workaround was attempted

evidence_quality.cause: S5 above: the q10/q90 artifacts do not isolate direction
evidence_quality.consequence: Even on a machine that HAS the three route files, running Gate S today would produce INCONCLUSIVE by design, because the tool now refuses to decide on confounded stress cases. That refusal is correct: the alternative is an unattributable answer.
